_readme: Hand-maintained event facts. npm run event merges this with what it reads from data/luma-events into src/data/event.json. listed=true puts the tab in the nav (labelled with name) while live=false keeps it a preview: every minigame shows, with the scaffolding disclaimer. live=true means the event is running. activeGames lists minigame keys confirmed for this event; once live, only those show. gameNames gives an active game this event's name for it (manor -> Manor 2). newGames names games running this event that the pinned code doesn't have, so they show without a guide. trickOrTreat (null if the event has none) is read in game, like the shop. sourceEvent names the event the luma-events code at data/luma-events.commit was written for; while it differs from name, the pages say the numbers come from that event's code.
